roadmap_scope: Phase 13 is the shared helper tranche, but its named anchors remain libfs, devres, and Landlock, so this lane stays bounded to a read-only notifier foothold that mirrors upstream generic notifier shapes without promoting notifier/list interop to a new named anchor.

gaps.why_now: The shared Phase 13 replay now compiles both the reviewability gate and the read-only notifier-chain helper directly.
The reviewability gate now records the landed Zigux-side notifier binding and helper foothold instead of only the earlier absence proof.
The survey note now records the published read-only notifier foothold and keeps registration, execution, SRCU, and blocking semantics explicitly out of scope.

The current repo already exposes ListHeadRef and HListHeadRef plus the list and hlist summary flags, which means list-shaped interop still provides the reusable companion surface for this bounded notifier foothold.
The existing list view helper already models bounded list_head traversal without claiming mutation, so the notifier foothold can stay read-only and companion-shaped.

The existing list, hlist, and raw-notifier helpers now expose the same bounded `viewFromHead`, `isEmpty`, `length`, and `summarize` read-only API shape, which keeps the interop story reviewable without widening into mutation or callback execution.
The shared Phase 3 build already replays the list helpers directly, which keeps the list side of the interop story observable beside the new notifier foothold.
Notifier-like behavior in the current repo was previously chrdev-local only, which is why this new shared helper slice stays generic and read-only.
The Phase 11 hvc packet already showed notifier callbacks living near list linkage, which remains useful upstream evidence for the shared read-only surface.
A public upstream notifier consumer still proves the generic contract exists independently of the new Zigux mirror.
The upstream header still fixes the read-only shape that the new Zigux binding mirrors.
The public DSA header still keeps list and notifier shapes adjacent, which remains useful evidence for the helper-first interop story.
The public watchdog header still shows notifier fields and list linkage in one exported layout, which helps judge the read-only binding mirror honestly.
This run lands the smallest reusable Zigux-side generic notifier mirror: read-only `notifier_block` and `raw_notifier_head` references plus bounded chain view and summary structs.

This run also lands the bounded helper that surveys raw notifier-chain linkage with empty, terminated, truncated, and self-loop coverage while staying out of registration, callback execution, SRCU, and blocking semantics.
